import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3
            + t*(p[4] + p[5]*A + p[6]*A**2)
            + p[7]*np.sqrt(t)*A**2 + p[8]*np.log(t)*A + p[9]*np.exp(-t)*A**2)
